item.title: Generating ICS Files to Display Sunrise and Sunset Times on Google Calendar
item.description: I developed a tool to calculate sunrise and sunset times for any given location and generate files in a format compatible with Google Calendar. This article documents the development process and provides usage instructions. Update: Since this page appears to be getting some traffic, I’ve created a simplified ICS file distribution site for non-programmers. World and Japanese Sunrise/Sunset Calendar - ICS File Distribution You can copy iCal calendar URLs for various regions.
